register: Plain tu, neutral US Spanish, short sentences. Product names stay in English with their English article: The Forge, The Refinery, t.ROY. Documents stay English this pass.
how_to_use: status=locked entries are enforced by lib/__tests__/i18n-termbase.test.ts: no Spanish catalog value may match an avoid pattern. status=proposed entries are machine suggestions that wait for a bilingual reader; they are not enforced. Add an entry when a back-translation check or a reader finds a recurring problem.

terms.note: "antecedentes" alone can read as work background. Found in 16 back-translation flags on 2026-11-13. Work history is "historial laboral".

terms.es: borrar los datos de esta computadora
terms.note: The button erases saved work and signs the person out. "Limpiar" reads like cleaning the machine and "borrar esta computadora" like erasing the machine. Say what is erased: the data on it.
Back-translation found it rendered as Completa. Normal is the same word in both languages.
Strings use "lugar", which reads as a physical place. Needs a native reader to confirm "cupo".
"socio" reads as a business partner or spouse. Proposed by the comparison pass.
"centro" alone does not say jail or prison. Applied in the record-choice screen; confirm wording and region with a reader.
"por encargo" was flagged as unclear. A native reader should pick the everyday word.
"gestor de casos" versus "administrador de casos". Reader should choose what reentry programs actually say.
